requirements.label: theory
requirements.title: Theory
requirements.sourceText: Theory: MUS 119 - The Elements of Music 3 credits OR MUS 130 - Sound Structures 3 credits; MUS 315 - The Structural Principles of Music I 3 credits; MUS 316 - The Structural Principles of Music II 3 credits. Notes: Students well versed in music notation and basic theory (demonstrated by the MUS 119 challenge examination) should take MUS 130 - Sound Structures

All courses offered for the minor in Jazz Studies must be passed with a letter grade of C or higher.

notes.text: Students must audition to be accepted to MUS 189, MUS 264, and MUS 267.

The minor is designed for students who are interested in jazz but who do not seek training in more sophisticated aspects of music theory and musicianship. Students well versed in music notation and basic theory (demonstrated by the MUS 119 challenge examination) should take MUS 130 - Sound Structures.

If a Music major wants to also do a minor in Jazz, he or she must undertake a relevant independent project under faculty supervision, taken as a 3 credit MUS 487 - Independent Project. This is not modeled as a rule because it applies only to Music majors.
